title: Karachi Building Collapse Survivor Recounts Ordeal
excerpt: A man rescued from a collapsed building in Karachi shared that he survived for over two days under the rubble by consuming gutka.
body_html:
A survivor of a building collapse in Karachi has shared details of his experience after being rescued from beneath the rubble. The man spent more than two days trapped following the collapse of a building located within Karachi's Administration Employees area.

According to the survivor, he had nothing else to consume during the ordeal and relied solely on gutka for three days while waiting for rescue crews to reach him.
